baseline.description: the executed plain-text/v1 default of the pinned pre-release revision, at the same Codex hook budget, no focus

projected.description: the executed auto/v1 default at the Codex hook budget, with the task focus

frozen_baseline_receipt.description: the frozen US-002 receipt, reproduced fixture by fixture by the control arm before any invocation

unbounded_raw.decision: The unbounded raw observation is not scored and consumes no invocation. The closed v5 qualification already measured it at 50 of 50 against 50 of 50 with a 0-point delta, and against a 25 of 26 retention ceiling it can only tie or lose, so it cannot discriminate. No claim resting on this evidence may assert parity with unbounded context.

billing.mode: existing ChatGPT Pro and Claude Max subscriptions
billing.note: CLI-reported equivalent cost is usage telemetry, not an additional subscription charge.

sampling_parameters.temperature: host-controlled and not exposed by Claude Code

claude.tool_state: safe mode, no tools, no session persistence

model_distribution_asymmetry.definition: For each reported model id m, the asymmetry is the absolute difference between the number of baseline invocations reporting m and the number of projected invocations reporting m. The statistic is the maximum over all m, and it is computed once at the end of the run over the complete sample.

controls.deterministic_rubric: Strict JSON parse, exactly the declared keys, exact string equality against one complete source line that occurs exactly once in the raw observation.

disclosed_ceiling.consequence: ep006-24 is unanswerable in both arms, so it costs the candidate nothing in the delta and no GO requires the model host to fail a task. The two control retentions are the first line of a git show and a git log patch, which the prefix behavior of plain-text/v1 preserves. Every one of these numbers is reproduced before execution and none of them is a reason to reselect tasks.

confounds.note: It is absorbed by the delta floor and bounded by maximum_baseline_successes. A task answered from priors is never excluded after the fact.

scoring.confidence_method: conservative difference of two 95% Wilson intervals
